scope: Same-host development baseline for inherited Forward workload, including existing postprocess; not effects-off F0, complete F0-F8, or G05/G07 qualification
legacyProtocol: framegraph-021-default-path-preflight-v1 remains unchanged and its failed evidence is retained

calibration.selection: Earliest candidate at which both successive windows have stable three-cohort CPU P95 and pooled P50/P95 drift <=5% for every case and variant; do not inspect candidate speedup to choose a warmup

coldDefinition: Fresh browser profile/device; scenario setup and explicit pipeline compilation reported separately; startup CPU consists of the first 120 runtime frames after pipeline preparation. No OS/driver cache flush or GPU-cold claim.
steadyDefinition: Separate complete calibration chooses one common CPU warmup and one common GPU warmup for all cases and variants. Freeze both before 12 fresh baseline captures. CPU execution remains serial; only the GPU phase uses identical bounded eight-frame completion with engine retirement callbacks intact. Retain every warmup and measured frame, including partial batches; compare all 3000 CPU and 300 GPU samples per cohort. Chrome power preference does not guarantee P0 or fixed MHz.

gpuCalibration.selection: Earliest common candidate for both cases and variants: every remaining 300-frame window, including a final overlapping window when needed, of pass sum and whole GPU span has stable three-cohort P95; adjacent windows and each later window versus the first must have pooled and per-cohort P50/P95 drift <=5%. Never select by A0/B4 speedup. Retain all 10200 frames, without dropping the end of the calibration trace.
